[ELA 11/16 | Lesson #/Title] Session 9 and 10
[ELA 11/16 | Vocabulary & Strategy] Story Components · Plot · Conflict · Resolution · Beginning · Middle · End
[ELA 11/16 | Learning Target] I can identify key story elements from the beginning, middle, and end of a story, explain different characters’ perspectives, describe how the conflict is resolved, and use introductory words and phrases to organize my writing.
[ELA 11/16 | Success Criteria] Outline major plot points progressing across the beginning, middle, and end.
[ELA 11/16 | Success Criteria] Explain the ultimate resolution of the central narrative struggle.
[ELA 11/16 | Success Criteria] Incorporate introductory transitions to sequence concepts and structure written responses effectively.
[ELA 11/16 | Retrieval Activator] 11/20 Do Now Session 10 Pg. 85 - The Power of Perspective
[M 11/16 | Lesson #/Title] Lesson 15 - Multiply to Find Area
[M 11/16 | Standard] 3.GSR.7.1 Investigate area by covering the space of rectangles presented in realistic situations using multiple copies of the same unit, with no gaps or overlaps, and determine the total area (total number of units that covered the space).
[M 11/16 | Standard] 3.GSR.7.3 Discover and explain how area can be found by multiplying the dimensions of a rectangle.

[Sci 11/16 | Lesson Link, Science A-Z] Invertebrate fossils teaching tips
